steps: Open the production game at http://127.0.0.1:5214/ using Chrome.
Test reset confirmation and cancellation, then restart puzzle 1 through the public controls.
Use keyboard Space to fill row 1 column 2, arrow movement and X/Space to cross row 1 column 3.
Use real pointer input to drag-fill row 5. Undo and redo that stroke with the public buttons.
Verify pause/resume and help dialog dismissal. Fill the remaining solution squares through public clicks, without marking all empty squares.
Observe Little sprout, 1 / 12, and unassisted completion. Toggle optional error checking on the already completed puzzle and verify its unassisted record remains unchanged.
Reload to verify persistence. Later return to the completed puzzle via its public selector and capture the unedited browser page.
notes: Real local production gameplay, public-control input only. Original JPEG browser screenshot bytes retained without image editing. Full-page height may exceed the 1000px viewport. Browser extension warnings were unrelated to the game.
